name: Fortune Telling
description:
You've seen how fortune telling - real or not - can sway people's actions.

Choose a technique like palm reading, astrology or reading tea leaves. Once per long rest, you may spend 1 minute performing your technique to tell a humanoid creature's fortune, then select a skill. Whenever the creature rolls the selected skill, they get +1d. This effect lasts until they fail/lose a roll using the selected skill, up to a maximum of one day.

Describe your technique and to what degree you believe in it.
